suzhou-1.name: Humble Administrator's Garden
suzhou-1.bio: Suzhou's largest classical garden at 78 mu, a UNESCO World Heritage component in the old city's northeast.

suzhou-3.name: Lingering Garden
suzhou-3.bio: One of the largest classical gardens in Suzhou, part of the UNESCO-listed Classical Gardens of Suzhou.

suzhou-5.name: Lion Grove Garden
suzhou-5.bio: UNESCO-listed classical garden known for its rockery maze, close to the Humble Administrator's Garden.

suzhou-7.name: Suzhou Museum
suzhou-7.bio: I.M. Pei's museum beside the Humble Administrator's Garden, with a recreated Ming scholar's study.

suzhou-9.name: Shantang Street
suzhou-9.bio: Restored canal street about 3.8 km long, linking Changmen to Tiger Hill, with shops in traditional style.

suzhou-11.name: Mudu
suzhou-11.bio: Water town in Wuzhong District, famed for its history and visited six times by the Qianlong Emperor.

suzhou-13.name: Mountain Villa with Embracing Beauty
suzhou-13.bio: Rock and water garden at 272 Jingde Road inside the Embroidery Museum, UNESCO-listed in 1997.

suzhou-15.name: North Temple Pagoda
suzhou-15.bio: Nine-storey, 76 m pagoda at Bao'en Temple, once eleven storeys, visible from the train station.

suzhou-17.name: Pan Gate
suzhou-17.bio: Combined water and land gate in the old city wall's southwest corner, rebuilt in the 14th century.
suzhou-17.notes: Price includes garden, boat ride, gate and foot bridge.

suzhou-19.name: Ligongdi
suzhou-19.bio: A 1,400 m causeway across Jinji Lake, built in the Guangxu reign (1874-1908).

suzhou-21.name: Guanqian Street
suzhou-21.bio: Pedestrian-only shopping street near the centre, with craft shops and local restaurants in its back streets.
suzhou-21.notes: Free inferred: pedestrian street, no gate.

suzhou-23.name: Twin Pagodas
suzhou-23.bio: Pair of Northern Song brick pagodas beside the remains of an Arhat temple, with carved stone pillars.

suzhou-25.name: Xiyuan Temple
suzhou-25.bio: Buddhist temple just west of Lingering Garden in Wuzhong District.

suzhou-27.name: Suzhou Opera Museum
suzhou-27.wiki: Suzhou Museum of Opera and Theatre
suzhou-27.bio: Theatre museum in a Ming latticed-wood theatre, with Kunqu instruments, scripts, masks and costumes.
suzhou-27.notes: Price from older Wikivoyage listing, low confidence. ticketUrl BLOCKED: http://www.kunopera.com.cn/

suzhou-29.name: Suzhou Arts and Crafts Museum
suzhou-29.bio: Crafts museum opened in 2003 at 88 Northwest Street in a Qianlong-era building, with about 1,000 pieces.
suzhou-29.notes: Official site is branch of szmuseum.com (verified): https://www.szmuseum.com/

suzhou-31.name: Five Peaks Garden
suzhou-31.bio: Ming garden named for its five rock peaks, built by the painter Wen Boren and restored from 1979.
suzhou-31.notes: Price from Tarrying Garden listing, same garden.

suzhou-33.name: Suzhou Industrial Park
suzhou-33.bio: Planned district around Jinji Lake east of downtown, founded in 1994 under a China-Singapore agreement.

suzhou-35.name: Former Residence of Yu Yue
suzhou-35.bio: Former home and garden of the poet and scholar Yu Yue, in the Liuhuafang block near Guanqian Street.
suzhou-35.notes: Old listing, low confidence; 3-7 with tea. Name has no Wikipedia article.

suzhou-37.name: Suzhou Zoo
suzhou-37.bio: City zoo in Suzhou, one of the animal parks among the city's tourist attractions.

jiangnan-water-towns-2.name: Tongli
jiangnan-water-towns-2.bio: Canal town in Wujiang, home of the only UNESCO-listed Suzhou garden outside downtown.
jiangnan-water-towns-2.notes: Town ticket bundles shuttle and major sights (Wikivoyage); no price.

jiangnan-water-towns-4.name: Shen's Residence
jiangnan-water-towns-4.bio: Hall built in 1742 by descendants of Shen Wansan, southeast of Fu'an Bridge in Zhouzhuang.
jiangnan-water-towns-4.notes: Covered by Zhouzhuang town entry (Wikivoyage 160, conflicting figures 50-120); held for consistency. Draft's 'over 100 rooms' dropped.

jiangnan-water-towns-6.name: Qiandeng Ancient Town
jiangnan-water-towns-6.bio: Water town in Kunshan, 15 km south of the city, and a national historical and cultural town.

tinglin-garden-kunshan.name: Tinglin Garden
tinglin-garden-kunshan.bio: Early 20th-century traditional-style garden named for the scholar Gu Yanwu, whose literary name was Tinglin.

bacheng-old-street.name: Bacheng Old Street
bacheng-old-street.bio: Stone-paved street of mainly late Qing Jiangnan-style buildings, about 280 m long.

liuhe-tianfei-palace.name: Liuhe Tianfei Palace
liuhe-tianfei-palace.bio: Taoist temple in Liuhe, founded in the Yuan dynasty and rebuilt several times, where Zheng He prayed.

shang-lake-changshu.name: Shang Lake
shang-lake-changshu.bio: Lake scenic area in Yushan Town, Changshu, with a bamboo boat ride through a crane reserve.
shang-lake-changshu.notes: Price includes the bamboo boat ride.

dongting-mountain-lake-tai.name: Dongting Mountain
dongting-mountain-lake-tai.bio: Peninsula in Lake Tai in Wuzhong District, Suzhou, known as Dongshan.
dongting-mountain-lake-tai.notes: UNRESOLVED: no Wikipedia/Wikivoyage page; needs sourced facts, price and official site.

suzhou-2.name: Tiger Hill
suzhou-2.bio: Hill park said to resemble a crouching tiger, topped by a 48 m leaning seven-storey brick pagoda.
suzhou-2.notes: Wikivoyage 70 (60 off-season); a 2026 guide says 80/60. No official site found.

suzhou-4.name: Master of the Nets Garden
suzhou-4.bio: Small classical garden founded in 1140 and rebuilt in 1770, UNESCO-listed and among Suzhou's best proportioned.

suzhou-6.name: Canglang Pavilion
suzhou-6.bio: One of Suzhou's oldest scholar gardens, UNESCO-listed and more densely wooded than the others.

suzhou-8.name: Pingjiang Road
suzhou-8.bio: Historic street in the northeast old town, paved with hand-cut stones and lined with traditional-style shops.
suzhou-8.notes: Free inferred: open street, no fee listed.

suzhou-10.name: Hanshan Temple
suzhou-10.bio: Buddhist temple about 5 km west of the old city, founded in the Liang dynasty (502-557).
suzhou-10.notes: ticketUrl BLOCKED: http://www.hanshansi.org/ ; OTA price ~20 not used.

suzhou-12.name: Couple's Retreat Garden
suzhou-12.bio: Early 20th-century UNESCO-listed garden whose many small rooms and covered walkways suit a rainy day.

suzhou-14.name: Garden of Cultivation
suzhou-14.bio: One of Suzhou's best-preserved Ming gardens, UNESCO-listed, with the best part at the back.
suzhou-14.notes: Listed as YiPu Garden on Wikivoyage.

suzhou-16.name: Temple of Mystery
suzhou-16.bio: Taoist temple at the centre of old Suzhou, founded in the 3rd century, with small shops around the hall.

suzhou-18.name: Jinji Lake
suzhou-18.bio: Freshwater lake of 7.18 km2 in the middle of Suzhou Industrial Park, with two man-made islands.

suzhou-20.name: Suzhou Ferris Wheel
suzhou-20.bio: Ferris wheel on the east bank of Jinji Lake, rebuilt in 2025 at 128 m, with views over the lake.
suzhou-20.notes: Single 2026 guide price, low confidence; tickets via WeChat mini-program; no official site.

suzhou-22.name: Suzhou Silk Museum
suzhou-22.bio: Museum founded in 1991 on silk and embroidery, with old looms, demonstrations and ancient patterns.
suzhou-22.notes: Free per two guides, one older listing says 15: low confidence. ticketUrl unverified: https://www.szsilkmuseum.com/

suzhou-24.name: Suzhou Confucian Temple
suzhou-24.bio: Song-dynasty Confucian temple founded in 1035 that holds the Stele Inscription Museum and four great Song steles.

suzhou-26.name: Suzhou Embroidery Research Institute
suzhou-26.bio: Museum, workshop and shop for Suzhou embroidery, a craft with a history of about 2,000 years.

suzhou-28.name: Suzhou Pingtan Museum
suzhou-28.bio: Museum of Pingtan, storytelling and ballad singing in the Suzhou dialect, with live performances.
suzhou-28.notes: Show tickets listed with no amount.

suzhou-30.name: Garden of Pleasance
suzhou-30.bio: Very small UNESCO-listed garden in the heart of downtown, a place for a cup of green tea.

suzhou-32.name: Precious Belt Bridge
suzhou-32.bio: Stone arch bridge where the Grand Canal meets Tantai Lake, about 6 km southeast of central Suzhou.

suzhou-34.name: City God Temple of Suzhou
suzhou-34.bio: Chinese folk temple dedicated to the City God among the old streets of central Suzhou, free to enter.
suzhou-34.notes: Thin source (Wikivoyage name and Free only); bio needs a second source.

suzhou-36.name: Suzhou Archaeological Museum
suzhou-36.bio: One of Suzhou's newest museums, showing artefacts from archaeological sites in the Suzhou area.
suzhou-36.notes: Official site verified (https://www.szkgyjs.cn/) but price not read.

jiangnan-water-towns-1.name: Zhouzhuang
jiangnan-water-towns-1.bio: Canal town with 14 stone bridges, including Double Bridge and Fu'an Bridge, and the Shen and Zhang residences.
jiangnan-water-towns-1.notes: Price conflict: Wikivoyage 160 (stale), Ctrip 100, 2025 report 50 weekdays; none official.

jiangnan-water-towns-3.name: Luzhi
jiangnan-water-towns-3.bio: Historic canal town in Wuzhong District, 18 km east of Suzhou, home to Baosheng Temple.
jiangnan-water-towns-3.notes: Streets reportedly free with ticketed sights (aggregators only).

jiangnan-water-towns-5.name: Retreat and Reflection Garden
jiangnan-water-towns-5.bio: Classical garden in Tongli, UNESCO-listed in 2001 and the only one of its kind outside downtown Suzhou.
jiangnan-water-towns-5.notes: Guides conflict (50 vs 100); may be in the Tongli town ticket. tongli.net names the town not the garden: not used.

jiangnan-water-towns-7.name: Baosheng Temple
jiangnan-water-towns-7.bio: Buddhist temple in Luzhi town, called one of the top four Buddhist temples of the Jiangnan region.

kunshan-opera-museum.name: Kunshan Opera Museum
kunshan-opera-museum.bio: Museum of Kunqu and other opera in Kunshan's Bacheng area, free to enter.

zheng-he-park-taicang.name: Zheng He Park
zheng-he-park-taicang.bio: Memorial park to Zheng He in Taicang, with a museum and a replica of a treasure ship.

yu-mountain-changshu.name: Yu Mountain
yu-mountain-changshu.bio: Hill 300 m high and 6.5 km long in northwest Changshu, with a Great Wall section and an old temple at the top.
yu-mountain-changshu.notes: Yu Mountain National Forest Park gate fee (Wikivoyage). wiki title is Yushan (Changshu).

shajiabang-scenic-area.name: Shajiabang Scenic Area
shajiabang-scenic-area.bio: Tourist village beside Yangcheng Lake in Changshu, with a scenic area called Shajiabang Resort.
shajiabang-scenic-area.notes: 80 low season, 100 high (Wikivoyage). Only one sourced fact for bio.
